contexts.text: One of the Luke warm bore himself as if he had repented.
Try to compel such to repentance...
(In Jupiter) they are reduced to repent.
If they do not repent, death is denounced.
When they recover from disease.
Repent, and do the first works () = invert the state of their life... This is done by repentance. AR 85.
Repent () = that they should guard against these works, and do works which are good.
Gave her time to repent... and she repented not () = they do not recede.
Take heed, and repent () = attend, and vivify their dead worship.
Be zealous, and repent () = affection of truth and aversion to falsity.
They repented not () = not to recede from evils, but to remain in them. AR 698.
Thus he never repents, that is, performs repentance.
a. [3]. By these alternations he can... repent of his insanities: but if he has not repented in the world, he cannot afterwards...
Evil cannot be washed off (except) by repentance.
Man comes into this purpose (of abstaining from evils), if once or twice a year he explores himself, and repents of the evil he discovers.
Appeased as soon as the adversary repents.
Therefore has not repented of any evil.
The Spirits could not recover from the things they had accepted (here).
To repent = come into mind. AE 106.
To repent = to be dissociated from them. Repentance is nothing else; for no one has repentance, unless he actually separates himself from the things of which he has repented...
To repent of whoredom = to turn from falsities to truths... for repentance is an actual conversion from falsities to truths, and a dissociation and separation from them.
To repent = to separate one's self from falsities.
Repent = thus spiritual life.
Repentance in the hour of death, with the evil, effects nothing; but with the good it confirms.
Be zealous and repent = have charity.
Not bound up = not amended by repentance.
To repent = to turn from evils and the derivative falsities.
To repent = to lead a different life.
2. To the evil he performs the uses of repentance or reconciliation...
